description: Ask an SMT solver whether a constraint, requirement or satisfaction can be satisfied at all (%check, experimental), with a satisfying assignment when it can. Needs z3 or cvc5 installed; the status is unavailable otherwise.

name.description: qualified name of the constraint, requirement, satisfaction, part or analysis case

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: check

status.description: sat, unsat, unknown, unbounded, no-optimum or unavailable (no solver installed, or the element outside the solvable subset)

text.description: the prompt's report: the assignment, the conflicting conditions, the optimum
